title: QUIZ - 24
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Convert between units through an intermediate unit using two ratios in sequence
questions.question: Given \(1\text{ kilometer}=1000\text{ meters}\) and \(1\text{ meter}=100\text{ centimeters}\), how many centimeters are in 3 kilometers?
questions.explanation: Chain the conversions: \(3\text{ km}\times\frac{1000\text{ m}}{1\text{ km}}=3000\text{ m}\), then \(3000\text{ m}\times\frac{100\text{ cm}}{1\text{ m}}=300000\text{ cm}\).
questions.hint: Convert step by step through the intermediate unit, multiplying by each conversion factor in turn.

questions.learningObjective: Use a given unit ratio to convert a quantity from one unit to another
questions.question: Using the conversion ratio \(1\text{ minute}:60\text{ seconds}\), convert 17 minutes to seconds.
questions.explanation: Use the conversion factor: \(17\text{ minutes}\times\frac{60\text{ seconds}}{1\text{ minute}}=1020\text{ seconds}\).
questions.hint: Multiply by the conversion factor when converting from a larger unit to a smaller one.

questions.learningObjective: Use a given unit ratio to convert a quantity from one unit to another
